title: DVB-S2 LDPC Decoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/DVB_S2_LDPC_Decoder.md
text: Decode LDPC code according to DVB-S2 standard, 6 inputs, 5 outputs, {Code rate} sets Code rate; {FEC frame source} sets the source for FEC frame, {FEC frame type}, {Parallelism level}, {Code rate source} sets the source for code, {Algorithm} sets the lDPC decoding algorithm, {Source for scaling factor}, {Scaling factor}, {Decoding termination criteria} sets the termination criteria, {Source for number of iterations} sets the source selection for number of iterations, {Number of iterations} sets the number of decoding iterations, {Maximum number of iterations} sets the maximum number of decoding iterations and {Enable parity check output port} sets the parity check status. Values come from the instance.
